item.title: WVU Tech Women's Basketball squashes Mighty Oaks
item.description: BECKLEY, WV (WVNS) - WVU Tech Women's Basketball collected a much-needed win over Oakland City University, winning 90-46. Maggie Boroski knocked down 14 points and grabbed 6 rebounds for the Golden Bears. Alexis Sexton also chipped in 12 points and 7 assists. They put the Mighty Oaks away early to improve to 13-7.
